Arithmetic as stated: salaries 2 x 40,000; payroll FICA 15.3% x 80,000 = 12,240; each founder salary 40,000 + distribution 90,000 - 199A QBI deduction (20% x 90,000 = 18,000; wages are not QBI) = taxable 112,000 x assumed 33.3% combined rate = 37,296. Entity: CA 800 annual tax + 2,500 fee (receipts 610,000 in 500k-999,999 band, Cal RT 17942/17941 per ca_llc_franchise.md); CA corporate-franchise treatment not in library; Delaware costs not in library. NOT INCLUDED (would raise this total): Watson-type recharacterization exposure of 15.3% x 90,000 x 2 = 27,540 plus penalties/interest on 40,000 salaries for full-time consultants generating 610,000 revenue (Rev Rul 74-44; Watson 8th Cir 2012); Tomas 83 ordinary income 50,000 (stock for services) if incorporated; Priya 351 gain 39,000 if 80% control fails (it likely does, ~57%). Rates 33.3% and 15.3% are ASSUMPTIONS - no rate schedules exist in the library.

recommended_ca_llc_partnership_profits_i.assumptions: California LLC (no Delaware layer), default partnership taxation, no entity income tax. Proc. 93-27: 0 income on receipt; 0 on immediate liquidation) with capital vesting 3y/1y cliff. Flow-through: each 50% x 260,000 = 130,000. Self-employment tax (in payroll_taxes) 15.3% x 130,000 x 2 = 39,780 (assumes no 92.35% base reduction, no SS cap effect - not in library). 199A: consulting is SSTB but each taxable income (~104,000) is below the 2026 single threshold (~200,300, library says verify), so SSTB limit does not apply: deduction 20% x 130,000 = 26,000 each; taxable 104,000 x assumed 33.3% = 34,632 each. Entity: CA 800 + 2,500 gross-receipts fee. Future open item: each capital-vesting conversion for Tomas is measured at then-FMV (83) - unmodelled. Tomas's NRA-status U.S. taxation of his 130,000 share (filing, possible partnership withholding) is NOT addressed anywhere in the library - flagged, modelled symmetrically for comparison only. Client round 2 confirmed: Tomas in U.S. ~1/3 of the year (~122 days) - 2027 weighted 177.3 < 183, so he is likely NRA again in 2027; the partnership is the durable structure, not a waiting room for an S election. Confirmed personal facts: Priya single (San Diego); Tomas married in Mexico, no prenup, works mostly from Monterrey; clients U.S.-wide. Rates are ASSUMPTIONS (no rate authority in library).

SE tax and 199A as in the recommended option; rates ASSUMPTIONS.
